# Widget

> **File:** `config/Widget.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the Widget section: sizing for panels, cards, popouts and controls, and the card size every module grid starts from. Bars size their own widgets (Bar.enrichBarConfig).

### Properties

- `scale` (readonly real): The Interface scale, as a factor: text (Appearance.fontSize) and the sizes below grow with it
- `cardSize` (readonly int): How big module cards are, in % of what fills the overlay (OverlayConfig.cardUnitOn)
- `density` (readonly string): "compact" | "normal" | "roomy"
- `height` (readonly int): Height of buttons, fields and other controls
- `padding` (readonly int): Inner padding of panels, cards and controls
- `spacing` (readonly int): Gap between items inside panels, cards and controls
- `cardPadding` (readonly int): A module card's padding (OverlayConfig.cardPad)
- `radius` (readonly int): Corners of what sits inside something (cards, controls, rows, bar widgets); outer edges use Appearance.borderRadius
